teleology: Capture hard macro and rates-credit regime constraints at T-n so downstream reasoning has a deterministic view of the policy and growth backdrop.
mechanism: Runs tools.macro.macro across the configured FRED series set and writes a normalized MACRO table with series proxy, window statistics, z-score, second-derivative risk, and explicit error fields.
expectation: Return a MACRO artifact with ticker, Proxy, n, start, end, pct_change, z_score, risk_d2, and error fields for each configured series. Invalid series must surface as explicit errors rather than silent omission.
